description: This Java source file defines the `ServiceXaWrapper` class which acts as an XA resource wrapper for handling distributed transactions in the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages registration of commit and rollback services that are triggered during transaction commit or rollback, includes transaction suspension and resumption logic, and supports asynchronous operation modes. The class is marked as deprecated in favor of `ServiceSynchronization`. It extends `GenericXaResource` and implements methods like `commit`, `rollback`, and `prepare` to coordinate with the transaction lifecycle.

classes.name: ServiceXaWrapper
classes.description: XA resource wrapper for managing distributed transaction commit and rollback services, with support for asynchronous execution and transaction suspension/resumption.

methods.name: setCommitService
methods.description: Configures the service to be invoked on transaction commit, with optional execution mode and persistence.

methods.name: getCommitService
methods.description: Returns the name of the service set to run on commit.

methods.name: setCommitService
methods.description: Overloaded method to set commit service with context, async flag, and persistence.

methods.name: setCommitService
methods.description: Sets the commit service, optional user, context, async mode, and persistence flags.

methods.name: getCommitContext
methods.description: Retrieves the context used during commit service execution.

methods.name: setRollbackService
methods.description: Configures the service to be invoked on transaction rollback.

methods.name: getRollbackService

methods.name: setRollbackService

methods.name: setRollbackService

methods.name: runService
